text: 当地时间9月25日，国家副主席韩正在纽约出席联合国大会期间会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯，出席由中方主办的全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会，宣读习近平主席贺信并致辞。 会见古特雷斯时，韩正表示，当前国际形势变乱交织，以联合国为核心的国际体系面临多重挑战。今年是新中国恢复联合国合法席位55周年。55年来，中国始终坚持真正的多边主义，支持联合国在国际事务中发挥核心作用。维护多边主义、改革完善全球治理体系是当前国际社会普遍呼声。面向未来，中国将继续发挥负责任大国作用，积极推进自身理念倡议同联合国议程对接，以中国式现代化新成就为世界发展提供新机遇。
text_en: On September 25 local time, Vice President Han Zheng met with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in New York during the United Nations General Assembly, attended the high-level dialogue on the fifth anniversary of the Global Development Initiative hosted by China, read out President Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter and delivered a speech. When meeting Guterres, Han Zheng said that the current international situation is intertwined with changes and turbulence, and the international system with the United Nations at its core faces multiple challenges. This year marks the 55th anniversary of the restoration of New China's lawful seat in the United Nations. Over the past 55 years, China has always upheld true multilateralism and supported the United Nations in playing a central role in international affairs. Safeguarding multilateralism and reforming and improving the global governance system are the common calls of the current international community. Looking ahead, China will continue to play the role of a responsible major country, actively promote the alignment of its own concepts and initiatives with the UN agenda, and provide new opportunities for world development with new achievements in Chinese modernization.
